title: Dried Borewell Recharge Pit Manual
problem: Farmers leave dried-up borewell pipes open and abandoned. This causes dangerous accidents for playing children and stray animals.
idea: A safety and recharge manual: first close the open borewell safely, then (with experts) turn it into a rainwater recharge point. Check your village with the safety checklist.

widgets.heading: ✅ Is this borewell safe?
widgets.intro: Look at an old borewell from a safe distance with an adult. Tick what is true.

items.text: The pipe top is closed with a strong, fixed cap
items.te: పైప్ పైన గట్టి మూత బిగించి ఉంది

items.text: There is a fence or concrete platform around it
items.te: చుట్టూ కంచె లేదా కాంక్రీట్ దిమ్మ ఉంది

items.text: A warning sign is put near it
No open hole or pit around the pipe
The owner knows it must stay closed

bands.text: Safe! Thank the farmer for closing it. 👍
DANGER! Keep children away and tell the Panchayat today.

widgets.heading: 💧 Turning an old borewell into a recharge point (adults and experts only)

items.title: Close it first
items.text: The open hole must be capped at once. Children must never go near it.

items.title: Ask an expert
items.text: Ask the agriculture or groundwater office for advice before any work.
items.te: పని ముందు వ్యవసాయ లేదా భూగర్భజల శాఖను సలహా అడగండి.

items.title: Dig a pit around
items.text: Workers dig a pit around the casing pipe.

items.title: Filter layers
items.text: Fill with boulders, gravel and sand so only clean water goes down.

items.title: Cover safely
items.text: Cover the top with a strong grill or slab so no one can fall in.
items.te: ఎవరూ పడకుండా గట్టి జాలీ లేదా రాయితో మూస్తారు.

questions.q: You see an open borewell. What do you do?
options: Stay away and tell an adult
questions.why: Never go near an open borewell. Tell an adult or call 112 in an emergency.

questions.q: Who should do recharge pit work?
questions.why: Digging near borewells is risky work for adults only.

how: With a teacher, list open or unused borewells in your village (from a safe distance).
Ask Gemini for low-cost steps to safely cap a borewell and turn it into a recharge point.
Check the steps with an agriculture officer or teacher.
Make a simple picture manual in Canva: Close it, Ask expert, Pit, Layers, Cover.
Give the manual to the Sarpanch and farmers.
Never go near an open borewell yourself.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain in simple English and Telugu why open abandoned borewells are dangerous for children, how farmers can cap them safely, and how experts can turn them into rainwater recharge points.
